Alright,
Searchiong through google I came across the following

Minion A with THAN in combat with minion B with CEL

Minion A strikes with Withering
Minion B can use a discipline card for his strike but cannot there after
play cards that require a discipline (such as blur).

What I am wondering is can minion B play a blur at a point prior to the
Withering taking effect? Could he toss down the blur while first strike were
beiong declared or is after strikes are resolved the Only time that cards
granting additional strikes (other than strike cards that do this) can be
played?

Help appreciated.

-JTP
